statement: 浅水（SWE）链与精确色散的一阶频率比 = sqrt(kh / tanh(kh))，在 kh = 0.6283 时取 1.0622，即 SWE 快 6.22%。频率误差 <= 3%/5%/10% 的 kh 上限分别为 0.4300/0.5602/0.8106，由单调二分 swe_ratio(kh) = 1.03/1.05/1.10 独立求得。故在 IN48-N07 深度上浅水链的一阶频率误差超出 3% 判据，该低阶链只有在 kh < 0.4300 时才能作为频率参照。

scope.system: shallow-water equations vs exact linear dispersion
conditions: first sloshing mode, rectangular tank, finite relative depth kh
exclusions: frequency only: no amplitude/phase statement is made by this bound

notes: this bound is the transferable part of the mission: it is geometry independent
